text:
maria: Quick heads-up — proposing a rollout for tomorrow 10:00 PT. This is the v2.3.0 deploy: model pin (redwood-quant-v2), batching tweaks, and a small RN/telemetry change. Need ops standby and a clear rollback gate.
pm-jordan: Copy for internal announce looks good. Can we pin the message to #eng and staging channels? I want a 1-hour T-1 reminder. :thumbsup:
emily-qa: Will run the smoke checklist at T-30. I have a short prompt set for perf and correctness checks.
sre-alex: I'll be primary oncall 09:30-12:30 PT. Devon, you good as backup?
devon: Yep, I can take fallback 09:30-13:30. If anything noisy happens ping me and i'll join. :ok_hand:
maria: Cool. Draft RN snippet below (copy for internal):
```
Release v2.3.0 — Internal draft
- Model: pinned to redwood-quant-v2
- Performance: improved batching for short-context workloads (~10-20% token cost reduction)
- Fixes: kv-cache eviction bug under high-concurrency
- Observability: added per-route token breakdown in Console
Rollout plan: canary 10% for 30m, then 40% for 30m, full 100% if metrics stable.
Rollback criteria (immediate rollback if any triggered):
- Error rate > 2% (5xxs or generation failures)
- Tail latency > 2x baseline for >5min
- Token cost per request increases > 30% vs baseline
- Any new data exfil risk alerts from security
```
pm-jordan: That reads well. Add a one-liner about users: "No expected user-facing changes; minor perf improvements."
emily-qa: Test matrix: short/long prompts, streaming, tool-calls. I’ll post results in thread.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2026-03-22T10:00:00-07:00, canary=10%, stage-dur=30m. Command queued: `deploy --version v2.3.0 --pin redwood-quant-v2`
opsbot: Note — please ensure dedicated cache warmup in staging before canary. Suggest preheat script: `./scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh --routes=chat,generation`
sre-alex: We'll watch error rate (slo/error-rate), p50/p95 latencies, and token-cost dashboard. I’ll open a pinned dashboard link at T-5.
maria: Who will post the internal announce? I can blast at T-1h to eng and product.
pm-jordan: Please do. Use this copy: "Heads-up: v2.3.0 rolling out tomorrow 10:00 PT. Minimal user risk; standby ops in place"
devon: Quick note on rollback: keep both v2.2.1 and v2.3.0 hot for immediate pinback. Ops, confirm we can pin rollback within 2 minutes.
opsbot: Confirmed: automated pinback action available. Command: `ops pin-model --customer=global --version=v2.2.1` (can be executed from deploy console)
emily-qa: If I see any regression in sampling tests I’ll post the exact prompt and response diff. If it's a quality regression >5% we block.
maria: Final checklist for tomorrow:
- [x] RN copy approved by PM
- [x] QA smoke tests ready (emily-qa)
- [x] Oncall & fallback assigned (sre-alex, devon)
- [ ] Deploybot schedule confirmed (deploy-bot)
- [ ] Internal announce T-1h (maria)
- [ ] Canary dashboards pinned (sre-alex)
- [ ] Preheat staging cache (opsbot)
deploy-bot: Canary schedule locked. Will post canary start/finish timestamps to thread when triggered.
maria: Great — i'll send the T-1h announce and paste the RN. If anything changes i'll update here. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
